alps.title: BEAR.ApiDoc Documentation Audit Profile

descriptor.title: API Documentation Audit
descriptor.doc: The audit document. Inspects every operation of the generated API documentation and lists the documentation that is missing. A companion view to the main API documentation (index.html).

descriptor.title: Audited Operation
descriptor.doc: One HTTP operation (method + path) that has at least one documentation gap. Operations that are fully documented are omitted from the findings list.

descriptor.title: Documentation Gap
descriptor.doc: A single missing-documentation report for an operation, e.g. a missing response schema or operation summary.

descriptor.title: Finding Type
descriptor.doc: The category of the gap: response-schema, request-schema, class-summary, operation-summary, or alps. A stable machine token; the human message accompanies it as text.

descriptor.title: Operation Count
descriptor.doc: Number of HTTP operations scanned across all resources.

descriptor.title: Response Schema Count
descriptor.doc: Number of operations that declare a response JSON Schema.

descriptor.title: Request Schema Count
descriptor.doc: Number of operations that declare a request JSON Schema.

descriptor.title: ALPS Attribute Count
descriptor.doc: Number of operations carrying an ALPS attribute. Reported only when an ALPS profile is configured.
